infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vishakan Biotech FFM needs camera access so field officers can attach a photo to crop issue reports and visit logs.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vishakan Biotech FFM uses your location to record accurate check-in/check-out positions and verify field visits while you're using the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vishakan Biotech FFM tracks field officer location throughout company working hours (9 AM–6 PM) while checked in, for attendance verification and field-work confirmation. Tracking stops as soon as you check out.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Vishakan Biotech FFM tracks field officer location throughout company working hours (9 AM–6 PM) while checked in, for attendance verification and field-work confirmation. Tracking stops as soon as you check out.
